about: Tables for content/home-quotes.json's two readers: frontend/src/tests/content/home-quotes-rules.ts (Jest) and backend/tests/unit/docs/test_homepage_quotes_docs.py (pytest). Each reader runs every case against `files` (a case's own `files` replace those paths; null deletes one) and must give exactly its `refusals`, in order. Every refusal code a reader knows has a case here.

# Run the tool with one command (beta)

It installs the core profile in `us-west-2`. It is not for production data.

```bash
    npm install @example/tool
```
